say:1:1710702001:1.text: Your Majesty, Magister Merlin has arrived, and he is accompanied by this...
say:1:1710702001:1.source_cn: 陛下，梅林阁下已经来了，还有<male>他</male...
say:1:1710702001:1.male: Your Majesty, Magister Merlin has arrived, and he is accompanied by this...
say:1:1710702001:1.female: Your Majesty, Magister Merlin has arrived, and she is accompanied by this...

say:2:1710702002:1.text: No need for such a suspicious look, Lady Marge.
say:2:1710702002:1.source_cn: 别这么看着我，玛格丽特女士。

say:3:1710702003:1.text: I-it speaks?! Your Majesty, this is highly irregular. Allow me to remove—
say:3:1710702003:1.source_cn: 它……它会说话？！陛下，这太失礼了，请允许我将它——

choice_prompt:4:1710702003.text: I-it speaks?! Your Majesty, this is highly irregular. Allow me to remove—
choice_prompt:4:1710702003.source_cn: 它……它会说话？！陛下，这太失礼了，请允许我将它——

say:5:1710702004:1.text: You briefly explain the fox's significant role, stressing that his presence is essential for this report.
say:5:1710702004:1.source_cn: 你点到为止地解释了小狐狸在调查中起到了重大的作用，并严...
say:5:1710702004:1.male: You briefly explain the fox's significant role, stressing that his presence is essential for this report.
say:5:1710702004:1.female: You briefly explain the fox's significant role, stressing that his presence is essential for this report.

say:8:1710702006:1.text: It's alright, Marge. Anyone who travels at Merlin's side has earned my trust.
say:8:1710702006:1.source_cn: 无妨，玛格丽特。能随梅林同行，便值得信任。
say:8:1710702006:1.male: It's alright, Marge. Anyone who travels at Merlin's side has earned my trust.
say:8:1710702006:1.female: It's alright, Marge. Anyone who travels at Merlin's side has earned my trust.

say:9:1710702007:1.text: Leave us now. Guard the door and let no one approach.
say:9:1710702007:1.source_cn: 你先退下，守住门口，任何人不得靠近。

say:12:1710702009:1.text: Please, sit. I've just received the report from the hunting grounds. A giant spider... Is Orion alright?
say:12:1710702009:1.source_cn: 二位请坐，猎场那边的报告我刚收到，说出现了巨型魔蛛袭击...

choice_prompt:13:1710702009.text: Please, sit. I've just received the report from the hunting grounds. A giant spider... Is Orion alright?
choice_prompt:13:1710702009.source_cn: 二位请坐，猎场那边的报告我刚收到，说出现了巨型魔蛛袭击……奥利安他还好吗？

say:14:1710702010:1.text: You don't mince words, laying out everything you discovered along the way.
say:14:1710702010:1.source_cn: 你没有浪费时间，迅速将这一路的调查结果全盘托出。
say:14:1710702010:1.male: You don't mince words, laying out everything you discovered along the way.
say:14:1710702010:1.female: You don't mince words, laying out everything you discovered along the way.

say:15:1710702011:1.text: From the spiders at Silken Snare, the false sword wrapped in webs within the Hall of Ancients, to Peggy and Cassadee still in there...
say:15:1710702011:1.source_cn: 从丝绒陷阱的蜘蛛，到圣古堂内那把被蛛丝缠绕的伪剑，再到...

say:16:1710702012:1.text: You piece together the scattered clues before the Queen, revealing the full conspiracy.
say:16:1710702012:1.source_cn: 你将这无数散落的拼图，在王后面前拼成了一幅完整的阴谋画卷。
say:16:1710702012:1.male: You piece together the scattered clues before the Queen, revealing the full conspiracy.
say:16:1710702012:1.female: You piece together the scattered clues before the Queen, revealing the full conspiracy.

say:17:1710702013:1.text: ... I understand. Peggy couldn't draw the sword because of that backhanded trick.
say:17:1710702013:1.source_cn: ……原来如此。佩吉无法拔剑，是因为剑被“锁”住了。

say:18:1710702014:1.text: And the giant spider at the hunting grounds must be connected to Voracia.
say:18:1710702014:1.source_cn: 而袭击猎场的巨蛛，必定和法蒂玛脱不了干系。

say:19:1710702015:1.source_cn: 显然，这场袭击是一出苦肉计。

say:21:1710702016:1.text: A brilliant one, too. Lure the sharp-eyed Hendrik away, play the victim, and use the chaos to exile Gwyneth from the capital... Orion thinks fast.
say:21:1710702016:1.source_cn: 这戏演得真好。把敏锐的亨德里克调走，把自己塑造成受害者...

say:22:1710702017:1.text: The Prince is quite clever. Even I'm impressed.
say:22:1710702017:1.source_cn: 耀光有这样“优秀”的后继人，真是让狐狸瞠目结舌，可喜可贺呢！

say:23:1710702018:1.text: But I don't understand why Orion would go this far. To forge Excalibur, to make the Hall of Ancients vanish...
say:23:1710702018:1.source_cn: 但我不明白，奥利安为什么要这么做？不惜伪造石中剑，让圣...

say:24:1710702019:1.text: Maximilian is still fighting for his life. If the worst should happen, Orion could lawfully claim the throne. The inheritance... it would all be his.
say:24:1710702019:1.source_cn: 马克西姆还在与死神抗争……倘若、倘若真到了那一刻，奥利...

say:25:1710702020:1.text: I wouldn't stop him. Peggy wouldn't challenge him. So why this... this convoluted scheme?
say:25:1710702020:1.source_cn: 我并不会阻挠，佩吉也不会与他争夺。他何苦如此大费周章呢？

choice_prompt:27:1710702020.text: I wouldn't stop him. Peggy wouldn't challenge him. So why this... this convoluted scheme?
choice_prompt:27:1710702020.source_cn: 我并不会阻挠，佩吉也不会与他争夺。他何苦如此大费周章呢？

say:28:1710702021:1.text: You explain the third symbol, wings, and your discovery at the remote tower.
say:28:1710702021:1.source_cn: 你进一步解释了第三个意象——翅膀。你们在猎场边缘的塔楼...
say:28:1710702021:1.male: You explain the third symbol, wings, and your discovery at the remote tower.
say:28:1710702021:1.female: You explain the third symbol, wings, and your discovery at the remote tower.

say:29:1710702022:1.text: It concealed the <style="highlight">true Excalibur</style>, and an <style="highlight">imprisoned Mauler</style>.
say:29:1710702022:1.source_cn: 那里不仅藏着<style=highlight>真正的石...

say:30:1710702023:1.text: The true sword... and a Mauler?

say:31:1710702024:1.text: You describe the winged man, bound by dark magic, yet fiercely loyal to Orion.
say:31:1710702024:1.source_cn: 你解释了那名蛮血的状态——他背生双翼，被强大的黑魔法禁...
say:31:1710702024:1.male: You describe the winged man, bound by dark magic, yet fiercely loyal to Orion.
say:31:1710702024:1.female: You describe the winged man, bound by dark magic, yet fiercely loyal to Orion.

say:32:1710702025:1.text: You speculate that all of Orion's actions may be tied to the secret of this Mauler.
say:32:1710702025:1.source_cn: 你推测，奥利安所有的疯狂举动，或许都与这个蛮血守护的“...
say:32:1710702025:1.male: You speculate that all of Orion's actions may be tied to the secret of this Mauler.
say:32:1710702025:1.female: You speculate that all of Orion's actions may be tied to the secret of this Mauler.

say:34:1710702027:1.text: I thought he was merely being influenced by the conservative nobles, eager to prove himself.
say:34:1710702027:1.source_cn: 我本以为，他只是被那些保守派的臣子们裹挟，急于证明自己。

say:35:1710702028:1.text: I never imagined he was entangled in something so dark...
say:35:1710702028:1.source_cn: 没想到他竟涉入如此之深……

say:37:1710702029:1.text: That Mauler fellow's quite the clam, too. Wouldn't utter a word.
say:37:1710702029:1.source_cn: 那个蛮血也可疑得很，问什么都不肯说。

say:38:1710702030:1.text: If this Mauler is the key, then we must uncover his secret at any cost.
say:38:1710702030:1.source_cn: 既然那个蛮血是核心，我们就得不惜一切代价弄清他的秘密。

say:39:1710702031:1.text: Even if his mouth is sealed, I have ways to bypass restraints and peer directly into his soul.
say:39:1710702031:1.source_cn: 即使他被封口，我也有办法绕过禁制，直接窥探到他灵魂深处...

say:40:1710702032:1.text: But to form such a deep mental link, I need a <style="highlight">medium</style>.
say:40:1710702032:1.source_cn: 但是……要建立这种深层的精神连接，我需要一个<styl...

say:41:1710702033:1.text: In that tower, did you find anything that belonged to him?
say:41:1710702033:1.source_cn: 梅林，你们在那座塔楼里，有没有拿到属于他的物品？
say:41:1710702033:1.male: In that tower, did you find anything that belonged to him?
say:41:1710702033:1.female: In that tower, did you find anything that belonged to him?

choice_prompt:42:1710702033.text: In that tower, did you find anything that belonged to him?
choice_prompt:42:1710702033.source_cn: 梅林，你们在那座塔楼里，有没有拿到属于他的物品？
choice_prompt:42:1710702033.male: In that tower, did you find anything that belonged to him?
choice_prompt:42:1710702033.female: In that tower, did you find anything that belonged to him?

say:43:1710702034:1.text: Humans do have a tendency to overlook the details, don't they? Lucky for you, I had quick paws and borrowed a feather.
say:43:1710702034:1.source_cn: 哎呀，你们人类做事就是容易不周全。还好本狐眼疾手快，借...

say:44:1710702035:1.text: Here you go. No need to thank me!

say:46:1710702036:1.text: ... Little fox, your knowledge is remarkable. You know of the lost scabbard, and could even tell the real sword from a fake.
say:46:1710702036:1.source_cn: ……阁下。您知道早已失传的剑鞘所在，甚至能识别石中剑的真假。

say:47:1710702037:1.text: More than that, your awareness of court intrigue seems... unsettlingly sharp.
say:47:1710702037:1.source_cn: 不仅如此，您对这宫廷内的风云诡谲，似乎……太过了如指掌了。

say:48:1710702038:1.text: Oh, I just listen when people talk! Courts are very noisy places.
say:48:1710702038:1.source_cn: 哎呀，本狐是道听途说嘛！

say:49:1710702039:1.text: "Just listen"? Some of what you know, even Maximilian might not. I can only assume...
say:49:1710702039:1.source_cn: 道听途说？您所知晓的信息，甚至连马克西姆都未必了如指掌...

say:50:1710702040:1.text: That's a tale for another time, I think.
say:50:1710702040:1.source_cn: 现在还不是说这个的时候。

say:51:1710702041:1.text: ... Very well. Regardless of who you are, you have my profound thanks. With this, we can find our answers.
say:51:1710702041:1.source_cn: ……我明白了。总之，无论阁下是谁，都万分感激。有了这个...

choice:42:1:2.source_cn: （回忆起小狐狸临走之前薅下的羽毛）
choice:42:1:2.male: (Recall the feather he got before leaving)
choice:42:1:2.female: (Recall the feather he got before leaving)

choice:27:0:1.text: It may be about the wings.
choice:27:0:1.male: It may be about the wings.
choice:27:0:1.female: It may be about the wings.

choice:27:1:2.male: We found someone in the hunting grounds' tower.
